chunks: And the Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Isma'il ibn Hammam al-Kindi, from al-Rida عليه السلام, who said:
Tayammum is one strike for the face and one strike for the two palms.

key_terms.ضَرْبَةٌ: a strike; a placing or striking of the hands upon earth or similar material for tayammum
key_terms.لِلْكَفَّيْنِ: for the two palms; indicating the hands/palms as the other required area in tayammum
key_terms.لِلْوَجْهِ: for the face; indicating the face as one of the required areas in tayammum
key_terms.ٱلتَّيَمُّمُ: tayammum; the dry ablution performed in place of wudu (ablution) or ghusl (ritual bath) under specific conditions

ai.seo_question: How is tayammum performed according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the manner of tayammum in a concise legal form. It indicates that tayammum consists of one strike for the face and one strike for the two palms, making it a ruling related to ritual purity and worship.
